result.instructions: Tools for Molzait, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who is booked at our restaurant tomorrow evening, and how many guests?"; "Find free slots for a party of four on Saturday for our dinner experience."; "Show me the guests who visited the most in the last year.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Molzait data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run molzait_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run molzait_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run molzait_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. molzait_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: molzait_get_restaurant
tools.title: Get restaurant details
tools.description: Get the restaurant this API key belongs to: name, address, timezone, contact details and branding. Good first call to confirm which restaurant is connected. Molzait API: GET /external/restaurant.

tools.name: molzait_list_labels
tools.title: List restaurant labels
tools.description: List the labels the restaurant uses to tag reservations and guests (VIP, allergy, and so on). Use the label ids when you filter guests or set labels on a reservation. Molzait API: GET /external/restaurant/labels.

tools.name: molzait_list_floor_plans
tools.title: List floor plans
tools.description: List the floor plans of the restaurant with their tables, table combinations and elements. Use table ids from here when you pin tables to a reservation. Molzait API: GET /external/floorplans.

tools.name: molzait_search_guests
tools.title: Search guests
tools.description: Search the guest directory by name, email, phone or company, with visit counts and labels. Use it to find a guest id before you list their reservations. Molzait API: GET /external/guests.

search.description: Free-text search over the guest name.

hasEmail.description: Only guests with (true) or without (false) an email address.

hasPhone.description: Only guests with (true) or without (false) a phone number.

tools.name: molzait_list_reservations
tools.title: List reservations
tools.description: List reservations in a date range, optionally for one guest or one status. Each reservation has its experience, times, tables, guest and labels. Molzait API: GET /external/reservations.

guestId.description: Only reservations of this guest id (from molzait_search_guests).

includeWalkIns.description: Include walk-in guests (default as the API decides).

tools.name: molzait_get_reservation
tools.title: Get a reservation
tools.description: Get one reservation by id: status, times, attendees, experience, guest, pinned tables, notes and labels. Molzait API: GET /external/reservations/{reservationId}.

tools.name: molzait_list_receipts
tools.title: List receipts of a reservation
tools.description: List the point-of-sale receipts of one reservation: products, waiters and table. Molzait API: GET /external/reservations/{reservationId}/receipts.

tools.name: molzait_list_experiences
tools.title: List experiences
tools.description: List the bookable experiences of the restaurant (for example lunch or dinner menus) with their party-size limits. Use the experience id when you check slots or book. Molzait API: GET /external/availability/experiences.

tools.name: molzait_list_available_slots
tools.title: List available slots
tools.description: List the bookable time slots for one experience, day and party size, with open spots per slot. Molzait API: GET /external/availability/slots.

reservation_id.description: Existing reservation id, when you check a change to it.

tools.name: molzait_list_gift_card_templates
tools.title: List gift card templates
tools.description: List the gift card templates the restaurant sells, with amounts, variations and expiry rules. Molzait API: GET /external/gift-cards/templates.

tools.name: molzait_get_gift_card
tools.title: Get a gift card
tools.description: Get one gift card by id: amount, remaining amount, template, expiry day and locale. Molzait API: GET /external/gift-cards/{giftCardId}.

tools.name: molzait_create_reservation
tools.title: Create a reservation
tools.description: Book a reservation for one experience, day, time and party size. The guest is found or created from the name, email and phone. Creates a real booking that the restaurant sees. Molzait API: POST /external/reservations.

minutes.description: Start time in minutes since midnight in the restaurant timezone (600 = 10:00).

notes.description: Special request notes for the restaurant.

pinned_table_ids.description: Table ids to pin. Omit to let the restaurant choose.

label_ids.description: Label ids to set on the reservation.

tools.name: molzait_update_reservation
tools.title: Update a reservation
tools.description: Change one reservation: its status (for example cancelled or no_show), day, start time, party size or tables. Only the fields you pass are sent. Changes the live booking. Molzait API: PATCH /external/reservations/{reservationId}.

minutes.description: New start time in minutes since midnight (600 = 10:00).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Molzait
prompts.description: What you can do with Molzait here, with example requests to try.
